admin0RelationOverride.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: Palestine is included. In OpenStreetMap the only relation carrying ISO3166-1=PS is relation 1703814 (Palestinian Territories), tagged boundary=disputed with no admin_level because its border is disputed; the default admin-0 rule (boundary=administrative, admin_level=2) therefore finds none. Every other proof (member ways, area assembly, segment match) still applies. OSM mapped boundary, not legal-border authority.
